name: Durban
housing: Durban renters live in apartment blocks on the Berea and the coast, and in houses and townhouses in the suburbs.

localRules.text: South African landlords must keep the deposit in an interest-bearing account and refund it with interest, less any agreed costs.

tenantHelp.name: KwaZulu-Natal Rental Housing Tribunal
tenantHelp.what: free provincial tribunal for rental disputes

climate: Durban is hot and humid, so check for mould and test the air conditioning or fans.
fact: Durban's humid subtropical climate makes mould a common move-out issue.
